text_blocks.snippet: Dercum's disease, also known as adiposis dolorosa, is a rare condition characterized by the development of painful, subcutaneous lipomas (fatty tumors). These lipomas are often found on the trunk, upper arms, and upper legs, but can also appear on other parts of the body. The disease is more common in obese women, particularly those over 35.
